text:
Maria: Quick sync — Wed panels (final round x3). Need a couple quick confirmations before we lock: 1) backup interviewer for 4pm SRE slot, 2) someone to scribe the debrief for the 2pm panel, 3) a quick CR on two small PRs that are blocking candidate prep. Can people confirm availability? cc @Ajay @Jess @Sam (recruiter)

Ajay: I can cover 4pm SRE slot if needed. free 3:45–5:30 PT. :+1:

Jess: Happy to scribe debrief for the 2pm panel. Which rubric are we using? I think we had an update to weights?

Sam (recruiter): Use rubric v2.1 in the hiring drive — I uploaded the latest. Also candidate opted into recording, pls confirm invite has Zoom + consent note.

Maria: Thanks — recording consent confirmed. I'll add link to invite. Rubric note: system design weight bumped up; short diff below:
```
- system_design: 30 -> 40
- coding: 40 -> 35
- communication: 30 -> 25
```

Ajay: Noted. I'm OOO until ~10:30 PT tomorrow but can try to review after that. Which PR numbers are blocking?

Maria: PRs are #4821 (candidate test harness flaky timeout) and #4830 (docs + takehome clarifications). Quick checkout: `git fetch && gh pr checkout 4821` — timeout repro in logs: `timeout at 5s` in harness runner.

Jess: I'll take #4830 now and leave doc comments, should be quick. Ajay if you can look at #4821 that would be great.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invites created for Wed 2pm / 3pm / 4pm. Zoom links added, recording toggle set to host-only.

Sam (recruiter): Can we add a tiny checklist in the invite body: "read takehome, scribe assigned, recording consent"? makes it easier for external guests.

Maria: Done — added checklist and pinned the rubric + PR links to the invite. Final ask: call out if you can cover any backfills here. Current plan: Ajay covers 4pm, Jess scribes 2pm. :thumbsup:

Ajay: Confirmed for 4pm. I'll glance at #4821 around 10:45 PT and flag anything blocking.

Jess: Confirmed scribe for 2pm. Good luck team :)
